verdict.rationale: Orama's core library runs entirely in-process via Node.js with no server dependency, confirmed by a hands-on runtime probe executing create→insert→search in a single script (orama-probe-rt-1), making it trivially embeddable in CI/build pipelines or automation scripts. It's a JS/Rust/Python library with npm packaging (orama-docs-12, orama-docs-21) rather than a GUI-bound tool, so headless automation is inherent to its design. missing for 10: no explicit CI-pipeline example/docs (e.g., GitHub Actions recipe) or a dedicated CLI/automation guide beyond the generic library API.
